run_convert_checkpoint_cli: run the CLI to convert a fine-tuned checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint
convert_finetune_to_release: convert a fine-tuned PyTorch checkpoint to a release format by copying backbone config from the starting checkpoint
convert_finetune_yaml_config: convert a fine-tune YAML config to a release YAML by removing finetune_config and copying backbone and heads
review_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: review the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function to understand how it merges starting checkpoint config into fine-tuned checkpoints
refactor_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: refactor convert_fine_tune_checkpoint to support additional checkpoint fields beyond backbone and heads
